description: Score support tickets for escalation and churn risk from live signals.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined.

notes.note: Churn is visible in support tickets weeks early, and scoring those signals turns support into retention — that's a real, sellable ROI story at $15/agent/mo. Weakest assumption: it stays standalone; Zendesk and Intercom will ship 'churn risk' as a native score. Win on being the neutral layer across all of them.
Run risk scan + ticket modal work; zero errors.

notes.change: Ticket modal gained 'Draft reply' — opens an editable, risk-tiered reply draft (critical=2h personal outreach, high=4h ownership) pre-filled with the ticket's suggested next action, with one-click copy for Zendesk/Intercom. README next-3 #2 done.
